appearances.whereabouts: Leads the party from The Queen's Blessing through Caemlyn streets to a cellar with a Waygate, then into the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Uses her staff to open the rusty lock on the cellar doors, creates a glowing ball of light, opens the Waygate by manipulating the Avendesora leaf, closes the Waygate behind the party, directs the group to hurry

appearances.whereabouts: Travels from The Queen's Blessing with the party, enters the Ways first, rides beside Loial through the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Leads the way through the darkness, closes the cellar doors after entering, distributes food at midday, encourages Loial not to surrender before being beaten

appearances.whereabouts: Travels from The Queen's Blessing through Caemlyn to the cellar, enters the Ways, travels on bridges and ramps
appearances.notable_actions: Observes the journey, leads the pack horse at first, lights lanterns, enters the Waygate, grips his sword repeatedly for comfort, seeks the void, eats while riding
appearances.demeanor: anxious, observant, seeking calm through meditation, worried about the oppressive darkness

appearances.whereabouts: Travels with the party from The Queen's Blessing through Caemlyn into the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Stays close to Rand, expresses worry about Perrin acting strange, grumbles about taking horses indoors, moves slowly through the Waygate as if through jelly, eats while riding
appearances.demeanor: nervous, worried, complaining, seeking reassurance from Rand

appearances.whereabouts: Travels with the party from The Queen's Blessing into the Ways, leads the pack horse at midday
appearances.notable_actions: Travels almost as calmly as the Warder, leads the pack horse, presses close to others in the darkness
appearances.demeanor: calm on the surface but noted as acting strange by Mat, seeks comfort from human contact in the Ways

appearances.whereabouts: Travels from The Queen's Blessing through Caemlyn into the Ways, rides Bela in the middle of the column
appearances.notable_actions: Goes straight to Bela in the stable, enters the Ways, presses close to Rand in the darkness, gives Rand a wide-eyed look
appearances.demeanor: anxious, looks as if she wishes she could rethink her decision to come, frightened by the darkness

appearances.whereabouts: Travels from The Queen's Blessing through Caemlyn into the Ways, rides in the middle of the column
appearances.notable_actions: Goes to her long-legged mare in the stable, complains about smells in the alleys, enters the Ways, presses close to others in the darkness
appearances.demeanor: practical, complaining about the smells, anxious in the Ways

appearances.whereabouts: Travels from The Queen's Blessing through Caemlyn to the cellar, leads the party through the Ways reading Guidings
appearances.notable_actions: Feels the direction to the Waygate, stumbles in the dark stableyard, grumbles about moving in darkness, offers to pull the lock off, expresses anger at the destruction of trees, reads Ogier script on the Guidings, leads the group across bridges and up ramps, discovers a broken bridge ahead
appearances.demeanor: anxious, angry about the lost grove, fearful of the Ways, dutiful in guiding despite fear

appearances.whereabouts: At The Queen's Blessing, leads the party through the kitchen to the stableyard
appearances.notable_actions: Soothes the cook, leads them across the stableyard, lends Rand the bay horse Red, confers with the head groom, explains the hidden door, laughs about having an inn without rats, wishes them well, expresses loyalty to the Queen and Tar Valon

appearances.whereabouts: In the stable at The Queen's Blessing
appearances.notable_actions: Knuckles his forehead to Master Gill, confirms the way is clear, manipulates hidden latches to open the secret door, hops impatiently waiting to close the door again
appearances.demeanor: dutiful, efficient, impatient to close the secret door

appearances.notable_actions: Previously informed them about Whitecloaks watching the inn

appearances.whereabouts: With Lan throughout, from The Queen's Blessing into the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Stands arrogantly in the stable, ignores everyone but Lan, enters the Waygate first with Lan, balks briefly at the shimmering surface, takes comfort from other horses in the Ways
appearances.demeanor: arrogant, loyal to Lan, somewhat nervous in the Ways

appearances.whereabouts: With Moiraine throughout, from The Queen's Blessing into the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Stretches nose to nuzzle Moiraine's hand, steps delicately down the cellar ramp behind Moiraine, follows Moiraine through the Waygate

appearances.whereabouts: With Rand throughout, from The Queen's Blessing into the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Is led by Rand, dislikes the ramp into the cellar, leaps through the Waygate nearly knocking Rand down, whickers softly in the darkness
appearances.demeanor: nervous, skittish, uncomfortable in the Ways

appearances.whereabouts: With Egwene throughout, from The Queen's Blessing into the Ways
appearances.notable_actions: Egwene goes straight to her in the stable, carries Egwene through the journey
None; used as a point of comparison for Red's temperament

appearances.whereabouts: Not present; exists in Rand's memories
appearances.notable_actions: None; Rand remembers his teaching about the void and sword forms
